messages:
lena: Hey — getting a support ticket: dashboard shows no p95/p99 lines for model latency after today's canary deploy. Customer sees only avg and p50.
devon_sre: Ugh, saw a couple internal alerts about missing quantiles too. Any error logs from Grafana/TSDB?
maya_support: Ticket says affected orgs: 3 customers, started ~10:12 UTC. They attached screenshot of the latency chart with just mean/p50.
lena: Repro: open Console -> Observability -> Model latency -> select model 'rwf-7b-opt' -> timeframe 1h -> quantiles dropdown shows 50 only.
sam_engr: Quick hypothesis: the metrics pipeline changed the metric name or label set so the percentile query no longer matches. We rolled a metrics aggregator change in the canary at 10:05.
devon_sre: Checking ingestion logs now. I see p95/p99 series being ingested earlier, but after 10:06 there are datapoints with a new label set: `quantile=\"0.95\"` became `q=\"p95\"` in the new exporter. That would break the Grafana query which expects `quantile`.
lena: That sounds plausible. @deploy-bot do we have the deploy diff for the metrics exporter?
deploy-bot: Deployed commit 7c3a2f -> metrics-exporter service at 2025-06-14T10:05:37Z. Diff summary: label rename `quantile` -> `q` (see PR #4121).
maya_support: Customer-facing: any ETA on workaround? They are seeing major tails missing in SLO reports.
sam_engr: Workaround: Grafana query can be updated to accept both labels, something like `{__name__=~\"model_latency_seconds\"} |= \"quantile\" or q` — but PromQL doesn't do that directly. Better: use normalized label via recording rule or update the exporter to restore `quantile` label.
devon_sre: Fastest fix: rollback metrics-exporter to previous image (pre-7c3a2f) in canary then promote. I'll open a rollback.
lena: Before rollback, can we add a temporary recording rule: `model_latency_quantile{quantile=\"0.95\"} = model_latency_seconds{q=\"p95\"}` — ops, recording rules need config reload and restart, might take longer. Rollback is quicker.
sam_engr: I'll prepare a hotfix PR to keep `q` but also emit `quantile` for compatibility. Then we can redeploy.
maya_support: Customers notified about an acknowledged issue and we are rolling back the exporter.
devon_sre: Rollback started at 10:20 UTC. Monitoring: Grafana series for p95 coming back now for canary orgs, should propagate to the dashboard.
lena: Confirmed on my side: p95/p99 lines are reappearing in the dashboard for the affected model in 10m range.
maya_support: I told the reporting customers we'll follow up when hotfix is live.
sam_engr: After rollback I'll merge the compatibility PR and schedule a controlled deploy with feature flag for label rename. Also adding an automated test to catch label renames in future.
deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 2025-06-14T10:24:02Z for metrics-exporter.
lena: Thanks team. Postmortem action items: (1) add label-change alert during deploy (2) add unit test in exporter CI (3) update dashboards to be resilient to alternate labels or use recording rules.
maya_support: Filing a follow-up with affected customers and include repro steps and timeline.
devon_sre: I'll keep this thread updated if anything else pops up.
lena: Closing for now, reopen if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
